column1: # NOTE: keep this file ASCII-only; PlatformIO parses it with the system
#       default codec (GBK on zh-CN Windows) and non-ASCII comments will
#   PIO no longer parses this CSV for upload offsets. It hardcodes
#   boot_app0.bin @ 0xE000 and uses board_upload.offset_address for the app.
# nvs       data nvs      0x9000    0x5000    ; 20 KB     - key/value store (WiFi/BLE/Config)
# otadata   data ota      0xE000    0x2000    ; 8 KB      - OTA boot selector (fixed @ 0xE000)
# phy_init  data phy      0x10000   0x1000    ; 4 KB      - RF calibration data
# ota_0     app  ota_0    0x20000   0x300000  ; 3 MB      - active app firmware
# ota_1     app  ota_1    0x320000  0x300000  ; 3 MB      - OTA backup slot
# storage   data spiffs   0x620000  0x3E0000  ; 3.875 MB  - SPIFFS (config / keymap / fonts / WAV / PNG)
# coredump  data coredump 0xA00000  0x10000   ; 64 KB     - core dump (crash backtrace capture)
